# Horizontal Angle Towards

Source: [wiki article 4627](../archive/4627.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Horizontal Angle Towards](../../api/values/horizontal-angle-towards.md).

<a id="wiki-4627-n1"></a>

- Horizontal Angle Towards is relative to the player's current forward direction and positive for targets to the player's left.
